purpose.zh: 坐在椅子上拉伸大腿后侧
purpose.en: Stretch the back of your thigh from your chair.

text.zh: 腿向前伸直，背部拉长从髋部前折
text.en: Straighten the leg forward and fold from your hips with a long back

text.zh: 坐在椅子前部，脚跟着地，脚尖勾起
text.en: Sit near the front of the chair, heel down, toes up.

text.zh: 双手沿大腿向膝盖滑，拉伸感出现就停
text.en: Slide your hands toward your knees and stop once you feel the stretch.

commonErrors.en: Rounding the back to reach the foot.

cautions.zh: 大腿后侧疼痛或发麻时减小幅度，仍不适就停止
cautions.en: Ease off if the back of your thigh hurts or tingles, and stop if it continues.
